name: [BR] 02 - Vizard Processor v3: pendentes → node Vizard (createClips)

parameters.query:
WITH requeued AS (
  UPDATE videos_pendentes
  SET status = 'pendente',
      erro_mensagem = 'Reenfileirado: travado sem projectId',
      updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE status = 'em_processamento'
    AND (vizard_project_id IS NULL OR vizard_project_id = '')
    AND updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '20 minutes'
  RETURNING id
),
candidatos AS (
  SELECT id, canal_id, url_video, titulo_original, duracao_segundos, nicho, views, engagement_pct, created_at,
    ( LEAST(COALESCE(views,0), 500000)::numeric / 500000 * 0.55
    + LEAST(COALESCE(engagement_pct,0), 25)::numeric / 25   * 0.25
    + GREATEST(0, 1 - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - created_at)) / 1209600) * 0.20 ) AS score_qualidade
  FROM videos_pendentes
  WHERE (status = 'pendente' OR id IN (SELECT id FROM requeued))
    AND duracao_segundos BETWEEN 60 AND 7200
    AND ( (nicho = 'copa'  AND COALESCE(views,0) >= 2000)
       OR (nicho <> 'copa' AND COALESCE(views,0) >= 5000) )
),
ranqueados AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY nicho ORDER BY score_qualidade DESC, created_at ASC) AS rn
  FROM candidatos
)
SELECT id, canal_id, url_video, titulo_original, duracao_segundos, nicho, views, engagement_pct, score_qualidade
FROM ranqueados
WHERE rn <= 2
ORDER BY (CASE WHEN nicho = 'copa' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END), rn ASC, score_qualidade DESC
LIMIT 5;

=UPDATE videos_pendentes
SET status = 'em_processamento', updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $json.id }}'
  AND status = 'pendente'
RETURNING id;

=UPDATE videos_pendentes
SET
  status = CASE '{{ $json.outcome }}'
    WHEN 'ok'    THEN 'em_processamento'
    WHEN 'retry' THEN 'pendente'
    WHEN 'perm'  THEN 'erro'
    ELSE status
  END,
  vizard_code = {{ $json.vizard_code !== null && $json.vizard_code !== undefined ? "'" + $json.vizard_code + "'" : 'vizard_code' }},
  vizard_project_id = {{ $json.vizard_project_id ? "'" + $json.vizard_project_id + "'" : 'vizard_project_id' }},
  erro_mensagem = {{ $json.erro_mensagem ? "'" + $json.erro_mensagem + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $json.video_pendente_id }}'
RETURNING id, status, vizard_code, vizard_project_id;
